caption: Is your to-do pile crowded but your day stays empty of real progress? This carousel shares a practical, repeatable workflow to plan and prune your week. Save it to reference before your next sprint. What tends to throw off your weekly plan? #AIinBusiness #Productivity #Prioritization

slides.title: Reality Check: Backlog
slides.body: Your backlog is overflowing but days won't stretch. Reality check: five prompts to plan and prune your week.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose priorities
slides.body: Diagnose priorities: Backlog: [list], Capacity: [units]. Output a ranked task list by impact/effort with due dates.

slides.title: 2. Refine plan
slides.body: Refine plan: Dependencies: [list], Buffers: [hours]. Output an updated ranking with dependencies and buffer notes.

slides.title: 3. Allocate tasks
slides.body: Plan allocation: Capacity: [units], Schedule: [week view]. Output a 7-day plan assigning tasks to days within capacity; flag overloads.

slides.title: 4. Check feasibility
slides.body: Check feasibility: Estimate effort vs. time; Actuals: [data]. Output any risk flags and a revised plan.

slides.title: 5. Automate reminders
slides.body: Automate: Reminders and updates: [tool]. Output a reusable workflow: prompts for reminders, updates, and CSV export.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: A simple, repeatable weekly prioritization reduces overwork and aligns effort with impact.
